name: posy
description: Make and edit a hand-made link-in-bio page: add links, pick a look, publish.

interface.longDescription: Posy is a free, open-source link-in-bio page that looks hand-made. Ask ChatGPT to build your page: it can claim your username, pick a look (Painted, Desk, Lofi, Washi, Cobalt or Night), add your links, socials, music and videos as tiles, change colours and fonts, and publish at posy.page/you. Nothing goes live until you publish. The free plan includes unlimited links and three looks; Pro adds a custom domain and three more looks.
defaultPrompt: Make me a Posy page with my GitHub, portfolio and newsletter.
Add my new podcast episode to the top of my Posy page.
Switch my Posy page to the Lofi look and publish it.

positive.expected_behavior: Returns the page's public URL, its tiles and whether anything is unpublished.

positive.prompt: Add https://posy.page/looks to my Posy page.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a link tile for https://posy.page/looks to the draft and says it is not live until published.

positive.prompt: Move the link I just added to the top of my page.
positive.expected_behavior: Moves that tile to position 0 in the draft.

positive.prompt: Switch my Posy page to the Lofi look.
positive.expected_behavior: Sets the theme style to lofi on the draft and confirms the change.

positive.prompt: Publish my Posy page and give me the link.
positive.expected_behavior: Makes the draft live and returns https://posy.page/posy-review.

negative.expected_behavior: Not supported: the tools edit the page only and cannot delete accounts. Explain that account deletion is done in Posy's settings.
The connection only reaches the signed-in user's own page. Explain it cannot edit other people's pages.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Tokyo next week.
negative.expected_behavior: Unrelated to Posy. The plugin should not call any Posy tool.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or process payments. Pro is bought on posy.page, not through the plugin.

publication.release_notes: First release: build, edit and publish a Posy link-in-bio page from ChatGPT.
